financialModel.basis: Independently derived from thread.ak, core.ak and catalogue.ak semantics. Moriarty asset units map to physical quantities by amount * 10^exp per catalogue row, each below 2^63. Per-stage physical assets, fees, min-ADA, collateral and current wallet balance are unknown, so all wallet-level results are symbolic equations; no balance, fee or denomination is invented.
financialModel.boundedInvoiceSlots: escrow 109 -> 72; seller 0 -> 35 (paid 0 -> 35); fee 2; gross debit 37; invoice liability 90 -> 55; reserve duty 14 unchanged; marker 7; opened true; 29 slots.
equations: post_escrow = pre_escrow - gross_debit, where gross_debit = transfer_to_seller + fee = 35 + 2 = 37 (instance: 109 - 37 = 72)
post_seller_external = pre_seller_external + 35 as exactly one payout leg of 35 * 10^exp plus its payout allowance (instance: 0 -> 35)
post_invoice_liability = pre_invoice_liability - 35 with discharge semantics (instance: 90 -> 55); discharge never increases a liability and requires the row present
reserve_duty_post = 14 (no effect names it; frame rule copies unrepresented rows unchanged)
custody_value_post = thread_token(1) + sum(mapped custody rows_post * 10^exp) + (reserve + topup) lovelace, exact equality; reserve_post = reserve + topup >= reserve_floor

claim_token: +1 minted at T2 under the C2 policy named blake2b_256(serialise_data(EnvV2)); -1 burned inside T3 on the settle path (no T3 output may hold the policy), or -1 burned in the alternative T_expire refund; never +1 carried through a successful settle

claim_carrier_lovelace: at T2 the claim output carries C = min-ADA-compliant carrier value (amount UNKNOWN until protocol parameters exist); on T3 success C is consumed as ordinary input value and disposed exactly by the builder's continuation/payout/change/fee accounting with no C2-token output; on T_expire the claimant recovers C minus the refund transaction fee

wallet_net_lovelace = -(T1_genesis_funding + T2_claim_carrier_C + sum of transaction fees) + collateral_returned + change_returned + reserve_returned_on_close; every term is UNKNOWN or symbolic until live parameters and built transactions exist

stake_credential_deposits: if target registration is required for any of VI/VS1/VS2/VS3/VS4, deposit_total = sum of per-credential deposits actually charged and reclaim_total = sum actually reclaimable on deregistration; both UNKNOWN until O-OPS-4R is resolved against primary Conway sources and the target
partialFailureRecovery: T2 succeeds and T3 never lands: after Finite(lower_bound) > env.expiry the claimant-signed T_expire burn reclaims the carrier; thread, custody and liabilities are unchanged; residual duties and the cancellation nonce (seq) survive.

T3 fails phase-1 (ledger) validation: the transaction is not admitted; no script runs and no value moves. Whether any cost is borne is a normative ledger question, not a proved per-transaction charge.

T3 is admitted but fails phase-2 (script) validation: ledger atomicity leaves thread, claim, custody and payouts unchanged; collateral may be consumed under Conway rules. This is a conditional normative obligation to verify against primary sources, not proof that every rejected or off-chain-built transaction costs money; off-chain construction failures cost nothing on-chain.
T3 lands: claim token burned in T3, carrier lovelace disposed per the builder table, continuation at seq+1 with event_chain advanced; no later claim action exists.

Revoke advances seq only, moves no value, and invalidates outstanding intents (nonce = seq); recovery requires fresh intents, a fresh statement and a fresh proof if seq-bound fields changed. Residual liabilities and duties survive Revoke and every failed stage.

obligations.text: Per stage (T0, T1, T2, T3, T_expire, Close) the builder must produce a complete affected/preserved asset table: every custody row, external payout, liability row, reserve, thread token, claim token, carrier lovelace, change and wallet lovelace, before any signing.
Min-ADA for the genesis thread output, claim carrier output, continuation and payout outputs must be computed from actual protocol parameters at build time; no sourced constant exists.

CORRECTED (Gemini F1, closes R1 O-FIN-3 as a question): the claim token is burned inside T3 (C2 spend plus c2.mint Burn -1, no C2 output) with the claimant Ed25519 signature in T3 extra_signatories; the carrier lovelace is disposed by T3 change/payout accounting. A separate burn transaction exists only as the post-expiry T_expire alternative. Host code must implement exactly this; the R1 single-tx versus two-tx choice is deleted.

Collateral selection and return, and change to the wallet, must be specified per transaction; sourced validators constrain none of it. Phase-1 versus phase-2 failure cost treatment must be verified against primary Conway sources before any numeric claim.

CORRECTED AND EXPANDED (Gemini F3): the actual Aiken invocation includes withdraw-zero for ALL FIVE of VI, VS1, VS2, VS3 and VS4. Pin, for each of the five, the registration requirement, certificate form, witness rule and deposit from normative Conway DELEG/UTXOW primary sources and a target experiment; those normative sources were not provided to Gemini or to this author, so no registration rule is asserted as an established legal fact from the Aiken calls alone. Until pinned, T3 is specified-only.

Transaction fit: measure 67028 B of reference scripts in T3 against live maxRefScriptSizePerTx, tiered minFeeRefScriptCostPerByte, maxTxSize and maxTxExUnits with a concrete built transaction; all values UNKNOWN today.

Observation contract: use /address_utxos with _extended = true, name the chosen epoch explicitly for /epoch_params, and establish value units and cost-model format from the actual response; establish slot-to-POSIX conversion from Preprod EraHistory (Byron transition included), never systemStart + slot * slotLength. Funding remains UNKNOWN until an authorised query observes it.

Generate and privately custody a fresh secp256k1 intent account keypair and freeze its public key in catalogue.accounts at T1. The Ed25519 wallet signs only Cardano transaction fields (T3 claimant extra_signatory, fee, collateral). Existing wallet keygen AUTH is spent and no existing key use is granted. Proving-key reuse for a fresh context requires prior descriptor and source-pin comparison (require_same) and a fresh exact-scope private-custody authorisation; that reuse is UNPERFORMED.

Before any fresh-context proof, compare the recompiled descriptor and source pins against the setup record; changing source asset identities can change program, shape and descriptor, and no fixed universal body length may be assumed. The 8 omitted compiler and 64 omitted Core/driver dependencies remain missing; no full circuit theorem is claimed.
